graph.title: Relation graph
graph.detailsDescription: Outgoing links from {{name}} are shown as cards and as a graph to keep the context readable.
graph.editorEmpty: Select a relation on the right to edit it without leaving the graph.
graph.narrativeDependencyPlaceholder: Why this link matters in the story...
graph.emptyDescription: Add a relation from the inspector to make it appear in the full-screen graph.

profileDraft.title: Generate character profile
profileDraft.description: Describe the character in one or two sentences. The draft will fill the main fields without silently overwriting the current form.
profileDraft.placeholder: e.g. A calm apprentice spy, expert in infiltration, wearing a midnight-blue coat and a dry sense of humor.

noCharacter.title: No character
noCharacter.description: Create the first profile to start the cast.

generation.sheetModalDescription: Generate the active character design sheet, with turnaround and reference palette.
generation.freeModalDescription: Generate one or more free images from the active sheet or from text-only data.
generation.sheetPrompt: A complete character design sheet, AAA concept art style, with turnaround (front/side/back), facial expressions, equipment breakdown, color palette, reference poses and world overview.
generation.sheetHint: The character design sheet always replaces the previous active sheet.
generation.insufficientData: Insufficient data. Add description and physical traits.
